source: gate-aura head: 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters representing the current Aura root
input: Decode head to exactly 32 raw bytes; JavaScript does not hash the head
adapter: bindPentora takes the pinned WASM instance exports; PentoraExpansion.pentora_expand takes raw head bytes and returns a copied 142-byte result

wasm.expand: pentora_expand(root_offset) returns a descriptor offset; zero refuses
wasm.descriptor: Four little-endian u32 words: version=1, status, data_offset, data_length
wasm.success: status=0, data_length=142: digest bytes [0,32), then 110 trit bytes [32,142), each 0..2
wasm.refusal: status=1: UTF-8 pentora:<reason>; all other versions or statuses refuse
wasm.release: Copy output before pentora_release_result(descriptor_offset); always release allocated root with pentora_release_root32(root_offset)

derivation: Only WASM derives sha256(UTF8(pentora.display.v1) || 0x00 || raw head) and expands its big-endian integer into 110 least-significant-first base-3 digits
rendering: The existing coherence canvas renderer receives the returned digest and fixed returned trits; it never calls the WASM expansion a second time
settling: First valid head renders immediately; keep picture and digest cleared for 1200 ms after a changed head, matching the Rust display settle interval; repeated identical heads retain that deadline; no wire keys are added
geometry: Existing coherence/geometry.ts maps trits in increasing cell order excluding centre 55; pinned geometry sha256 96b27c9b4de41cd961612be5b1e88d40e973a2fded16bd320415b3e15e3b8c61
unavailable: Clear picture and digest before head processing; missing head, invalid ABI/output, missing adapter, or stream failure stays cleared; superseded work and callbacks after abort cannot publish
health: Separate labelled canvas and decoder; health cells never enter PentoraExpansion
